summary: CKGSB's global marketing is in a launch-heavy sprint, with Asia Star and Intelligent China as the clear top priorities, while the team simultaneously finalizes the knowledge website redesign, kicks off the Women in Leadership Forum promotion, and resolves a lingering email lockout that has blocked access.
summaryDetail: The single most important thing right now is the email account lockout: stale saved passwords across devices caused repeated failed logins, and the team must delete and re-add accounts, update passwords on all devices, and confirm backend unlock with CKGSB before normal work can resume. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is nearing completion—the two-menu structure and BCI/BSI index banners are decided, videos will be dispersed by topic, and Joker is making final changes after a 30-minute feedback session; once the homepage launches, Ira will send the Flow Design PPT and email to Zongchao with both website URLs. The top program priority remains Asia Star and Intelligent China, with Joseph drafting target-audience lists, analyzing Asia Star participant profiles, and the team auditing Google Ads conversion tracking; US partner programs like Berkeley are secondary and will be included in the audit phase. This week also demands attention on the 2026 Women in Leadership Forum promotion kickoff, Joseph's video promotion plan for the Blue Carrot brand video and three Asia Start videos, and the Manaferra branding prompts review, while upcoming items include the YouTube edit plan for 233 videos, the ESG report feedback, and the Eurocham APEC event briefing for Professor Tao.

decisions.text: Stale saved passwords on devices caused repeated failed logins and account lockout; all devices must update credentials.
Remove the standalone videos section; disperse videos by topic across the site.
Keep the two-menu structure (Knowledge and School menus).
Bring BCI (and BSI) index banners into the knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Asia Star and Intelligent China are the top two program priorities; US partner programs are secondary.
Berkeley will be considered as a possible third priority and included in the audit phase.
Wait until the homepage is launched before sending the Flow Design PPT and email to Zongchao, and include both website URLs in the email and PPT
